test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A can paint a painting in 12 days. B can paint the same in 8 days. C can paint the same in 10 days. Find the (approximate) number of days in which the painting can be painted by A if he is accompanied by both B and C together on alternate days and A starts painting on the first day alone.
solution:
**Given:**

A can paint a painting in 12 days.

B can paint the same in 8 days.

C can paint the same in 10 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM(12, 8, 10) = 120

Efficiency of A = 120/12 = 10

Efficiency of B = 120/8 = 15

Efficiency of C = 120/10 = 12

According to question,

A if he is accompanied by both B and C together on alternate days. A start alone on first day.

Work completed in 2 days = 47

Work completed in 4 days = 47 × 2 = 94

Work completed in 5 days = 94 + 10 = 104

Remaining work = 16

Time to complete 16 units of work by three of them = 16/37 = 0.4 days

Total number of days required to complete the work = 5 + 0.4 = 5.4 days

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
